changelog:
Residue skill 1.0.3 is a major update redefining rarity, feeding, and care for the AI-native Residue pet.

- Changed Residue from "exotic/extreme" to "AI-native/rare" tier; new unlock mechanics (3+ adults, low death rate).
- Feeding window dramatically reduced from every 168 hours (7 days) to every 6 hours.
- Added support for care items on actions (e.g., feed with "dark matter"); item preferences and effects introduced.
- Pet status and care now include new fields: `death_clock`, `recommended_checkin`, `care_rhythm`, `milestones`, and evolution hints.
- Adjusted instructions and examples for API registration, adoption, status checking, and feeding to reflect new mechanics.
- Emoji changed to 🌀 to match updated branding.
- Various updates to wording, care strategies, and tags for clarity on pet nature and mechanics.
